goal_items.description: Implement the SRS and pass the fixed official SWE-EVO evaluator.

observations.summary: Runtime 在真实进程、独立 evaluator、checkpoint 和 recovery 路径下保持一致性。
经过 2 个 durable worker responsibility 和 12 次独立 evaluator 后仍未 resolved。
Worker 的本地验证曾通过，但独立 evaluator 仍失败，说明局部测试不足以证明目标完成。
同一 evaluator failure 在多轮 recovery 后仍重复出现。
有效 implementation responsibility 在多个 materialization attempt 间恢复原 backend session。
每个 durable execution node 使用独立 backend session；recovery 依赖显式 evidence，而非前序隐藏对话。

patches.rationale_summary: The required evaluator goal is open and the graph has no runnable node. Create one coherent primary worker to inspect the workspace and SRS, implement all required changes, and test and debug them before independent verification is considered against immutable implementation evidence.

The required goal is contradicted, no runnable node remains, and three evaluator attempts expose broad incomplete SRS implementation rather than a verification-only problem. A changed implementation strategy is required instead of repeating the prior version-only change or inserting another verifier.

The graph is exhausted while the required evaluator goal remains contradicted after repeated verification failures. A changed implementation strategy is needed because the prior worker only changed the project version and did not implement the objective's DVC change set; the evaluator diagnostics now provide a concrete regression map.

The required evaluator goal is contradicted after repeated verification failures, and no runnable node remains. A changed implementation strategy is required to reconcile the repository with the full SRS change set and the evaluator diagnostics rather than repeating the prior version-only change or dismissing failures as environmental.

The required evaluator goal remains contradicted after multiple failed verification attempts, and the graph has no runnable node. A single changed-strategy worker should replace the prior version-only approach with systematic reconciliation of the repository against the complete SRS and the evaluator’s concrete failure clusters.

The required goal remains contradicted after repeated evaluator failures, the graph has no runnable node, and the failures have converged to a stable set of plot, diff, dry-run, and path-conversion regressions. A single changed-strategy remediation node should diagnose and repair those remaining behaviors, validate the complete SRS change set, and produce valid immutable evidence for the fixed official evaluator.

The graph is exhausted while the required evaluator goal remains contradicted after repeated repair and verification cycles. A changed implementation strategy is needed to diagnose and resolve the stable remaining failure clusters rather than rerunning the same evaluator against incremental, incomplete fixes.

The required goal remains open with no runnable worker after repeated official-evaluator failures converged on a stable residual signature. A single changed-strategy worker is needed to obtain bounded diagnostics, correct the remaining compatibility defects, and produce fresh immutable evidence without adding another unsupported verifier node.

The required evaluator goal remains open after repeated failures with a stable residual signature, and the graph has no runnable remediation node. A single changed-strategy worker should obtain bounded diagnostics, correct the remaining behavioral mismatches, and produce a new immutable workspace revision for official reevaluation.

The graph has no runnable node, the required evaluator goal remains open, and repeated official evaluations have converged on an identical opaque failure signature. A single changed-strategy worker is needed to reconstruct expected behavior from the SRS and repository, obtain bounded parity diagnostics where possible, correct the remaining semantic mismatches, and produce fresh immutable evidence.

nodes.title: Implement the SRS and prepare evaluator-ready evidence
nodes.description: Inspect the repository and available SRS or task specifications, determine the required behavior, implement the complete solution, add or update appropriate tests, and run relevant validation. Keep inspection, implementation, testing, and debugging in one continuous worker session and produce immutable evidence suitable for the required independent evaluator verification.

acceptance_criteria: All requirements discoverable from the workspace SRS and task context are implemented coherently.
Relevant existing and newly added tests pass, including regression coverage for changed behavior.
The implementation preserves unrelated behavior and repository conventions.
The worker reports changed files, validation commands and results, and a concise mapping from implemented behavior to the SRS requirements.
No official evaluator, evaluator fixtures, or expected-result artifacts are altered to manufacture a passing result.
contract.outcome: A complete repository implementation of the supplied SRS that is ready for assessment by the fixed official SWE-EVO evaluator.

nodes.receipt_summary: Three consecutive official evaluations returned the identical remaining failure signature with test_id_only diagnostics while available local counterparts pass.

nodes.title: Implement the SRS and repair evaluator regressions
nodes.description: Inspect the current workspace, the complete objective change set, and the accumulated official-evaluator diagnostics. Replace the prior version-only approach with a repository-wide compatibility and behavior repair: implement the requested DVC changes, reconcile API and CLI behavior with the existing tests, add or update focused regression tests where needed, run the relevant test suites, debug failures attributable to the implementation, and produce immutable evaluator-ready evidence in one continuous worker session.

acceptance_criteria: The complete objective change set is inspected and all applicable requested behaviors are implemented in the current repository rather than reduced to a version-only change.

The currently reported evaluator regressions are reproduced where possible and corrected at their source, including API-signature, CLI-exit-code, plotting, diff, update, run/repro, stage, and compatibility failures.
Focused regression tests for changed behavior pass, and the broadest feasible evaluator-aligned test suite is run with failures diagnosed rather than broadly classified as unrelated.
Source and test changes are mutually consistent and do not merely alter tests to conceal incorrect product behavior.
The final result includes an immutable workspace revision, changed-file evidence, exact validation commands and results, and a valid structured worker receipt for independent evaluation.
contract.outcome: Deliver a coherent implementation of the repository SRS whose behavior resolves the official evaluator contradictions and yields immutable evidence suitable for required independent evaluation.

Reconcile behavior with the repository's expected legacy APIs and exact CLI/repository contracts, run focused tests after each coherent repair, then run the complete relevant validation suite and produce an immutable worker receipt for the fixed official evaluator.

acceptance_criteria: Inspect the current implementation and repository history or available specifications to map the full listed SRS change set to the expected code behavior rather than treating the task as a version-only update.
Reproduce and resolve all currently persistent evaluator failures, including the plots functional tests, diff command tests, stage dry-run behavior, and stage path conversion behavior.
Preserve exact expected command and repository API contracts, output formatting, exception semantics, and compatibility behavior demonstrated by the repository tests.
Run focused validation for every repaired failure cluster and run the broadest relevant repository test suite available in the parity environment.
Do not weaken, delete, skip, or rewrite tests merely to conceal implementation failures.
Produce immutable workspace and validation evidence suitable for the required independent official evaluator.

I’ll then concentrate on why the relocated stage and command tests still diverge despite their older local counterparts passing, using public module contracts and repository-owned test structure rather than test-name speculation.

The relocated stage test names line up with the public module split introduced by the stated “stage: moving things around” change, but the workspace still keeps all execution logic only as a `Stage` method. I’m adding the missing `dvc.stage.run.run_stage` contract and making the method delegate to it, preserving current behavior while allowing the refactored unit boundary to exercise dry-run logic directly. I’ll also add the corresponding stage-module compatibility export for path tests.

Since plural-plots callers can legitimately import the moved exception namespace, I’m restoring that source module and validating imports before recalculating the digest.

The new bounded result confirms that changing the plots revision label to `"workspace"` was incorrect for the plural API; I’ll restore `"working tree"` first. I’ll then concentrate on why the relocated stage and command tests still diverge despite their older local counterparts passing, using public module contracts and repository-owned test structure rather than test-name speculation.

The relocated stage test names line up with the public module split introduced by the stated “stage: moving things around” change, but the workspace still keeps all execution logic only as a `Stage` method. I’m adding the missing `dvc.stage.run.run_stage` contract and making the method delegate to it, preserving current behavior while allowing the refactored unit boundary to exercise dry-run logic directly. I’ll also add the corresponding stage-module compatibility export for path tests.
